current_difficulty_reason: The earlier numerical criterion for k-Du Bois singularities has a non-strict boundary and does not identify the lowest weight local-cohomology piece with the required intersection-complex Hodge module. The authors use duality to compare Hodge, order and weight filtrations and prove the necessary filtration-level isomorphisms in both directions, using the higher-codimension V-filtration Koszul description. This new comparison makes rationality equivalent to a strict minimal-exponent inequality, beyond simply quoting Saito's framework or the prior Du Bois criterion.
